overview: You began the fifth act at the oath: no woman within a mile, three years, four hands set to it. Under that you wrote that the four are sworn and the park is still empty. You did not take the sheet any further this sitting.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the oath and did not fill the space under it.

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Set down the oath and stopped

summary: Set down the oath and stopped
